title: Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
body:
Akbar Ne Sina Khai Hai Unko Na Batana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Kis Tarhan Se Dekhein Gi Wo Hum Donon Ki Ghurbat
Wo Roye To Aa Jaye Gi Khaimo Main Qayamat
Main Zakhm Chupa Leta Hoon Tum Ansoon Chupana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Tasweer e Muhammad Hai bade Nazo Se Paali
Mar Jaye Na Khaimo Main Meri Palny Wali
Har Giz Ye Mera Hath Na Seeny Se Hatana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mari Hai Sina Seny Pe Ye Keh Ke Laeen Ne
Phoolon Ki Tarhan Pala Hai Akbar Ko Phuphi Ne
Lashy Pe Abaa Kahimoon Se Pehle Hi Udha Na
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Is Baar Shahadat Ko Utha Le Gi Imamat
Bhai Se Chupana Nahi Ek Bhai Ki Ghurbat
Sajjad Ko Tafseel Shahadat Ki Suna Na
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Mamta Unhein Lashy Pe Mere Laye Gi Baba
Be Sakhta Wo Mujh Se Lipat Jaye Gi Baba
Mumkin Ho Tu Lashy Se Unhein Door Hatana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Ju Khak Bhari Hai Mere Balon Se Chura Do
Chehre Pe Laho Hai Mere Daman Se Hata Do
Wo Zidd Ju Zyada Kary Bas Chehra Dekhana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Yoon Naiza Sitam Gaar Ne Mara Mere Baba
Pehlo Bhi Shikasta Hai Hamara Mere Baba
Yaad Aay Ga Dadi Ka Unhein Zakhm Purana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phupi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Is Haal Main De Sabr Khuda Bint E Ali Ko
Akbar Ka Salam Akhri Keh Dena Phuphi Ko
Zinda Bara Mushkil Hai Mera Khaimy Main Jana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Har Baat Meri Apki Behnon Ke Liye Hai
Bas Ek Wasiyat Hai Meri Sughra Ke Liye Hai
Laa Kar Khat E Sughra Mere Lashy Pe Sunana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
10) Dam Todte Akbar Ko Na Pohanchy Koi Sadma
Muh Pher ke Yoon Rote Ho Maloom Hai Baba Par Samny Sadaat ke Ansoon Na Bahana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
<<DIVIDER>>
11) Hayeee Us Akhri Hichki Me Taqallum Hoa Mehshar
Ary Akbar Ne Kaha Hath Ju Peshani Pe Rakh Kar
Loo Hum Ko Ijazat Do Hamy Door Hai Jana
<<MINI>>
Baba Phuphi Amma Se Mera Zakhm Chupana
